intro: Dheenudaa Ajeyudaa is the latest Telugu Christian song from the album, Na Hrudaya Saradhi written, tuned and sung by Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer, international speaker by Pastor John Wesley. This worship song video was released on March 04, 2021 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
